  ```ts
  import { z } from 'zod';
  import { HttpError } from '../http-client.js';
  import type { Session } from '../session.js';
  import { confirmOrPreview } from './preview.js';
  import type { ToolDefinition } from './read-tools.js';
  import { page, pageArgs } from './reads.js';
  import { envelopeFor, submitOne } from './submit.js';
  import { readTicket } from './ticket-tools.js';

  const id = z.string().min(1);
  const enc = encodeURIComponent;
  const listShape = { workspaceId: id.optional(), projectId: id.optional(), ...pageArgs };
  const ticketShape = { workspaceId: id, ticketId: id };
  const discardShape = { ...ticketShape, confirm_name: z.string().optional() };

  /** One row of `GET /v1/me/drafts`. Only these fields are ever answered. */
  type MyDraftWire = {
    workspaceId: string;
    ticketId: string;
    projectId: string;
    projectName: string;
    title: string;
    typeId: string;
    parentId: string | null;
    updatedAt: string;
  };

  /** The three fields of a row of `GET /v1/workspaces/:id/drafts` that the erasure preview needs. */
  export type WorkspaceDraftWire = { ticketId: string; parentId: string | null; attachmentCount: number };

  /**
   * What discarding `rootId` erases besides the draft itself: every descendant draft and the attachments uploaded to the
   * draft and to them. A sibling's drafts are not in it. The `seen` set makes a corrupt `parentId` cycle end.
   */
  export function eraseSetOf(drafts: readonly WorkspaceDraftWire[], rootId: string): { subDrafts: number; attachments: number } {
    const children = new Map<string, WorkspaceDraftWire[]>();
    for (const d of drafts) {
      if (d.parentId !== null) children.set(d.parentId, [...(children.get(d.parentId) ?? []), d]);
    }
    let attachments = drafts.find((d) => d.ticketId === rootId)?.attachmentCount ?? 0;
    let subDrafts = 0;
    const seen = new Set<string>([rootId]);
    const queue = [rootId];
    while (queue.length > 0) {
      const next = queue.shift() as string;
      for (const child of children.get(next) ?? []) {
        if (seen.has(child.ticketId)) continue;
        seen.add(child.ticketId);
        subDrafts += 1;
        attachments += child.attachmentCount;
        queue.push(child.ticketId);
      }
    }
    return { subDrafts, attachments };
  }

  export function draftTools(session: Session): ToolDefinition[] {
    return [
      {
        name: 'list_my_drafts',
        description:
          'List your drafts: tickets only you can see, until you publish them. They have no key. Reads across every workspace you ' +
          'belong to; narrow it with `workspaceId` and/or `projectId`. Each draft names its project, type and parent. ' +
          'Pages with `cursor`; the response carries `nextCursor` (null on the last page).',
        inputSchema: listShape,
        handler: async (args) => {
          const a = z.object(listShape).parse(args);
          const q = new URLSearchParams();
          if (a.workspaceId !== undefined) q.set('workspaceId', a.workspaceId);
          if (a.projectId !== undefined) q.set('projectId', a.projectId);
          const qs = q.toString();
          const body = (await session.get(`/v1/me/drafts${qs === '' ? '' : `?${qs}`}`)) as { items: MyDraftWire[] };
          const paged = page(body.items, a.cursor, a.limit);
          return {
            // Named fields, never the row: whatever else the server sends stays on the server.
            items: paged.items.map((d) => ({
              workspaceId: d.workspaceId,
              ticketId: d.ticketId,
              projectId: d.projectId,
              projectName: d.projectName,
              title: d.title,
              typeId: d.typeId,
              parentId: d.parentId,
              updatedAt: d.updatedAt,
            })),
            nextCursor: paged.nextCursor,
          };
        },
      },
      {
        name: 'publish_draft',
        description:
          'Publish one of your drafts: it takes its key and joins the end of its project\'s Backlog, and everyone who can see the project ' +
          'can now see it. A draft whose parent is still a draft cannot be published until the parent is. The answer carries the new key.',
        inputSchema: ticketShape,
        handler: async (args) => {
          const a = z.object(ticketShape).parse(args);
          try {
            const out = (await session.post(`/v1/workspaces/${enc(a.workspaceId)}/drafts/publish`, { ticketIds: [a.ticketId], origin: 'mcp' })) as {
              results: Array<{ ticketId: string; key: string | null }>;
            };
            const row = out.results.find((r) => r.ticketId === a.ticketId);
            if (row === undefined) throw new Error('gisik-nokma published no ticket for this draft');
            return { ticketId: a.ticketId, key: row.key, published: true };
          } catch (error) {
            if (!(error instanceof HttpError)) throw error;
            if (error.status === 404) throw new Error('draft not found or not visible to you');
            const refused = (error.body ?? {}) as { rule?: unknown; cause?: { rule?: unknown; reason?: unknown } };
            if (error.status === 409 && refused.rule === 'draft.publish-refused' && refused.cause !== undefined) {
              // The engine's own rule and sentence, spelled as `submitOne` spells a refusal.
              throw new Error(`refused by ${String(refused.cause.rule)}: ${String(refused.cause.reason)}`);
            }
            throw error;
          }
        },
      },
      {
        name: 'discard_draft',
        description:
          'Discard one of your drafts: it is erased, with its sub-drafts and the attachments uploaded to them, and cannot be recovered. ' +
          'confirm_name must be the draft\'s exact title; without it you get a preview of what would be erased and nothing changes. ' +
          'Only a draft can be discarded: use delete_ticket for a published ticket.',
        inputSchema: discardShape,
        handler: async (args) => {
          const a = z.object(discardShape).parse(args);
          const ticket = await readTicket(session, a.workspaceId, a.ticketId);
          if (ticket.ticketState.draft === undefined) {
            throw new Error('This ticket is not a draft. Use delete_ticket to remove a published ticket.');
          }
          const preview = await confirmOrPreview(ticket.title, a.confirm_name, async () => {
            const { items } = (await session.get(`/v1/workspaces/${enc(a.workspaceId)}/drafts`)) as { items: WorkspaceDraftWire[] };
            const { subDrafts, attachments } = eraseSetOf(items, a.ticketId);
            return {
              sentence: `Erases the draft "${ticket.title}", ${subDrafts} sub-drafts and ${attachments} attachments uploaded to them (permanently deleted). Linked notes are kept. This cannot be undone.`,
              counts: { subDrafts, attachments },
            };
          });
          if (preview !== null) return preview;
          await submitOne(session, envelopeFor(session, a.workspaceId, { kind: 'ticket', id: a.ticketId }, 'ticket.discarded', {}));
          return { ticketId: a.ticketId, discarded: true };
        },
      },
    ];
  }

(T9): `planTailRank(rows, tailIds): { backfill, tail }` and `RankedRow` from `@gisik-nokma/domain`; the attachment routes for drafts. No event on a published ticket's stream ever names the draft. Part 2 T3 (`2026-10-03-wtg-part2-model.md`) builds "Leads to" on `isDraft` and this `eventFor` arm.

**Decisions the code forced, stated so a reviewer does not reopen them.**
1. **`TicketRead.draft` is mapped from `ticketState.draft`, not read from a second wire field** (T4 decision 2; spec §12.3 says the wire view "gains `draft?: true`", which is true of the view and is met by the mapper). `mapTicketState` enumerates its members by hand (`mappers.ts:1956-2040`, and its own docblock records `closed`, `rank` and `deleted` falling through it), so `draft` is added there, strictly: a `draft` key that is present must be `{ authorId: string, at: string }`. `mapTicketRead` then sets `draft: true` exactly when `ticket.draft !== undefined`.
2. **One new read, `getMyDrafts`, on `DataSourceQuery`, served by both sources.** Online it is `GET /v1/workspaces/:id/drafts`; the replica serves it from `listDrafts` (R22 keeps drafts off every other offline read). The replica has no project name and no attachment table, so it answers `projectName: null` and `attachmentCount: null`; `null` is "not known here", and the discard dialog says so (decision 7) instead of printing `0`.
3. **Publish is the client's two-part claim, not T5b's route.** The route is online only; the app publishes offline too (spec §12.4). `publishEvents` is `ticket.published {projectId}` followed by the `ticket.ranked` events of `planTailRank(visibleBacklogRows, [ticketId])`, built from the SAME read the Backlog tab uses (`getTickets(projectId, {}, 'flat')` filtered to `BACKLOG_STATE_ID`, `project/[projectId]/page.tsx:1271`), every ticket of the project and not only non-epics (T9 decision 8). Published first, ranks after: if the publish commits and a rank is refused, the draft IS published and draws among the unranked rows, so the outcome is `committed` and the reload shows where it landed (the cost is the one a drag already accepts, `backlog-rank.ts:195-199`).
4. **An offline accept is not an error.** `ingest` on the replica throws `OfflineAcceptError` for a queued claim. The draft paths treat it as `queued`: a saved draft calls `onDraftSaved` and its row stays (the replica lists it `pending: true`); a queued publish leaves the row and the sheet's pill in place, labelled `Waiting to sync`, until the server answers and the pull brings the key (R24: the replica has no key, and the settled state keeps `draft` until the server's `ticket.published` is folded). The non-draft create path is untouched.
5. **Optimism follows the smoothness rules, with one store.** The Drafts page and the nav badge are two `useLiveQuery` readers; the dialog is a third place. `draft-optimism.ts` holds the rows being saved; `useMyDrafts` puts them first and drops each one the moment the server's list contains its id, so a row cannot outlive its answer. A refusal removes the row and hands the typed draft back to the dialog (the same `restoreDraft` path the board ghost uses). Publish and Discard hide their rows at once and restore them on any answer that is not a commit.
6. **The forcing happens at ONE place: the flow.** The dialog says `draft: true`; `create-ticket-flow.tsx` is what builds the event, so it alone sends `start: 'backlog'`, no `stateId`, and `draft: true`, whatever the switch and the Starting-status select hold (Q6: the switch shows ON and disabled while the draft saves). An outsider assignee is refused in the flow before anything is sent, in R8's words (`Publish the ticket before inviting someone from outside`), because the outsider door would grant a membership as a side effect of a private act.
7. **Four strings are not in the plan header and are pinned by 28.150.** `Waiting to sync` (a queued row), `Could not publish this draft. Check your connection and try again.` (an unanswered publish or discard), `Attachments uploaded to this draft, if any, will be permanently deleted` (the replica cannot count, so the dialog names the loss without a number), and `Could not read this draft's sub-drafts. Try again.` (the sheet's Discard needs the list and does not guess a count of zero). Each is a plain sentence with no spaced em dash.
8. **The sheet's disabled controls are the ones its own doors expose and R7 refuses.** Move (the state row and the phone header shortcut) and Delete. Visibility is neither disabled nor offered: the server refuses `visibility.set` on a draft (spec R7, `packages/domain/src/draft.ts:5,9-18`), so the sheet does not render the visibility editor for a draft and shows R17's disclosure in its place (planner ruling 2026-10-04, follow-up; 28.195). Close and Reopen already do not render (a draft is in the Backlog, never terminal or closed). Each is disabled, not removed, with `title` and `aria-describedby` on `Available after you publish`, so the rows keep their height on publish. Comments are not offered (R61); History is not a tab (spec §12.3). Attachments and the Notes section are untouched (R56, R66).
9. **The sheet counts sub-drafts when Discard is pressed, not before.** A `getMyDrafts` per open sheet would be a request for every ticket ever opened. Pressing Discard on a draft reads the list once, and a failed read opens nothing and says so.
10. **The Open action on the saved toast reuses `Toast`'s action slot.** `Toast` has one action, spelled `undo` with an optional `label` (`toast.tsx`); `DraftSavedToast` passes `label: 'Open'`. There is no Undo for a saved draft (Discard is the way back), so no `undo` meaning is lost.
11. **Phone.** The same list at full width; below `40rem` the two actions collapse into one `Actions for <title>` menu button (`role="menu"` with two `menuitem`s). The Drafts link is in the top bar only: the phone bottom bar's slots are not changed by this plan (spec §12.2 names the nav).

**What the author can do after this task.** Save a ticket as a draft from the New ticket dialog and open it from the toast; see all their drafts, with a count in the nav, on one page; open a draft in the ordinary sheet, which says it is a draft, offers Publish and Discard, hides History and comments, and disables what a draft cannot do; publish it (it takes its key and lands last in the Backlog) or discard it after being told exactly what goes with it; and do all of it offline.

  /**
   * Drafts plan, Task 8. Every string the app shows for a draft, in one place. The first block is the plan header's
   * (spec §12), verbatim; the second is the four sentences the plan added (decision 7). No string has a spaced em dash.

  export const DRAFT_SAVE_LABEL = 'Save as draft';
  export const DRAFT_SAVED_TOAST = 'Draft saved';
  export const DRAFT_SAVED_OPEN = 'Open';
  export const DRAFTS_NAV_LABEL = 'Drafts';
  export const DRAFTS_EMPTY = 'No drafts. A draft is a ticket only you can see, until you publish it.';
  export const DRAFT_PUBLISH_LABEL = 'Publish';
  export const DRAFT_DISCARD_LABEL = 'Discard';
  export const DRAFT_PILL_LABEL = 'Draft';
  export const DRAFT_BANNER = 'Only you can see this draft.';
  export const DRAFT_DISABLED_REASON = 'Available after you publish';
  // R17's disclosure (spec `2026-10-03-drafts-design.md:182` asks for it but gives no words; these are the planner's,
  // planner ruling 2026-10-04, follow-up). The sheet shows it on a draft in place of the visibility editor, which is not
  // rendered there (R7 refuses `visibility.set` on a draft). It is ONE string in one `<p>`, so `getByText(DRAFT_BANNER)`
  // (exact match) still finds only the banner.
  export const DRAFT_VISIBILITY_DISCLOSURE = 'Only you can see this draft until you publish it.';
  export const DISCARD_QUESTION = "Discard this draft? It is erased and can't be recovered.";
  export const DISCARD_CONFIRM_LABEL = 'Discard draft';
  export const DISCARD_NOTES_LINE = 'Linked notes are kept and unlinked.';
  export const DRAFT_NO_OUTSIDERS = 'Publish the ticket before inviting someone from outside';

  export const DRAFT_PENDING_LABEL = 'Waiting to sync';
  export const DRAFT_UNREACHED = 'Could not publish this draft. Check your connection and try again.';
  export const DISCARD_ATTACHMENTS_UNKNOWN = 'Attachments uploaded to this draft, if any, will be permanently deleted';
  export const DRAFT_COUNTS_UNREADABLE = "Could not read this draft's sub-drafts. Try again.";

  export const subDraftsLine = (n: number): string => `${n} sub-draft${n === 1 ? '' : 's'} will be erased too`;
  export const attachmentsLine = (n: number): string =>
    `${n} attachment${n === 1 ? '' : 's'} uploaded to this draft will be permanently deleted`;
  export const draftParentLabel = (parentTitle: string): string => `under ${parentTitle}`;
  export const draftsNavName = (count: number): string =>
    count === 0 ? DRAFTS_NAV_LABEL : `${DRAFTS_NAV_LABEL}, ${count} draft${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;

    ```ts
    /** `GET /v1/workspaces/:id/drafts` → `DraftRow[]`. Named fields only: a key must never reach a draft row. */
    export function mapDraftRows(raw: unknown): DraftRow[] {
      return asArray(asRecord(raw, 'drafts')['items'], 'drafts.items').map((entry, index) => {
        const at = `drafts.items[${index}]`;
        const row = asRecord(entry, at);
        return {
          ticketId: asString(row['ticketId'], `${at}.ticketId`),
          projectId: asString(row['projectId'], `${at}.projectId`),
          projectName: row['projectName'] === null ? null : asString(row['projectName'], `${at}.projectName`),
          typeId: asString(row['typeId'], `${at}.typeId`),
          title: asString(row['title'], `${at}.title`),
          parentId: row['parentId'] === null ? null : asString(row['parentId'], `${at}.parentId`),
          updatedAt: asString(row['updatedAt'], `${at}.updatedAt`),
          attachmentCount: asNumber(row['attachmentCount'], `${at}.attachmentCount`),
          pending: false,
        };
      });
    }

  ```ts
  import { BACKLOG_STATE_ID, planTailRank, type IngestResult, type RankedRow, type SubmittedEvent } from '@gisik-nokma/domain';
  import type { DataSource } from '../data-source.js';
  import { OfflineAcceptError, type LocalIngestResult } from '../replica/replica-data-source.js';
  import type { MakeSubmitted } from '../submit.js';
  import type { DraftRow } from '../view-types.js';
  import { DRAFT_UNREACHED } from './drafts-copy.js';

  export type DraftOutcome =
    | { status: 'committed' }
    | { status: 'queued' }
    | { status: 'refused'; rule: string; reason: string }
    | { status: 'unreachable'; message: string };

  export type DiscardCounts = { subDrafts: number; attachments: number | null };

  /** Every descendant of `rootId` among the caller's own drafts, breadth first. A repeat is skipped, so bad data cannot spin. */
  export function subDraftsOf(drafts: readonly DraftRow[], rootId: string): DraftRow[] {
    const byParent = new Map<string, DraftRow[]>();
    for (const draft of drafts) {
      if (draft.parentId !== null) byParent.set(draft.parentId, [...(byParent.get(draft.parentId) ?? []), draft]);
    }
    const seen = new Set<string>([rootId]);
    const found: DraftRow[] = [];
    const queue = [rootId];
    for (let id = queue.shift(); id !== undefined; id = queue.shift()) {
      for (const child of byParent.get(id) ?? []) {
        if (seen.has(child.ticketId)) continue;
        seen.add(child.ticketId);
        found.push(child);
        queue.push(child.ticketId);
      }
    }
    return found;
  }

  /** What a discard of `rootId` erases besides the draft: its sub-drafts, and the files uploaded to it and to them. `null` when any count is unknown. */
  export function discardCounts(drafts: readonly DraftRow[], rootId: string): DiscardCounts {
    const root = drafts.find((d) => d.ticketId === rootId);
    const set = [...(root === undefined ? [] : [root]), ...subDraftsOf(drafts, rootId)];
    const counts = set.map((d) => d.attachmentCount);
    return {
      subDrafts: set.length - (root === undefined ? 0 : 1),
      attachments: counts.some((c) => c === null) ? null : counts.reduce<number>((sum, c) => sum + (c ?? 0), 0),
    };
  }

  /** The project's Backlog as this reader sees it: the rows `planTailRank` draws the new ticket after. Epics are included (T9 decision 8). */
  export async function visibleBacklogRows(source: DataSource, projectId: string): Promise<RankedRow[]> {
    const list = await source.query.getTickets(projectId, {}, 'flat');
    return list.rows.filter((row) => row.stateId === BACKLOG_STATE_ID).map((row) => ({ ticketId: row.ticketId, rank: row.rank }));
  }

  export function publishEvents(
    make: MakeSubmitted,
    input: { workspaceId: string; draft: { ticketId: string; projectId: string }; backlog: readonly RankedRow[] },
  ): SubmittedEvent[] {
    const { workspaceId, draft } = input;
    const plan = planTailRank(input.backlog, [draft.ticketId]);
    return [
      make({ workspaceId, entity: { kind: 'ticket', id: draft.ticketId }, type: 'ticket.published', payload: { projectId: draft.projectId } }),
      ...[...plan.backfill, ...plan.tail].map((assignment) =>
        make({ workspaceId, entity: { kind: 'ticket', id: assignment.ticketId }, type: 'ticket.ranked', payload: { rank: assignment.rank } }),
      ),
    ];
  }

  type DraftInput = { workspaceId: string; ticketId: string; projectId: string };

  const unreachable = (): DraftOutcome => ({ status: 'unreachable', message: DRAFT_UNREACHED });

  /** The first event's answer decides: a later refused rank leaves a published ticket, which is a commit. */
  function outcomeOf(first: IngestResult | LocalIngestResult | undefined): DraftOutcome {
    if (first === undefined) return unreachable();
    if (first.status === 'committed') return { status: 'committed' };
    if (first.status === 'refused') return { status: 'refused', rule: first.rule, reason: first.reason };
    if (first.status === 'invalid') return { status: 'refused', rule: first.code, reason: first.message };
    return { status: 'queued' };
  }

  async function submit(source: DataSource, events: SubmittedEvent[]): Promise<DraftOutcome> {
    try {
      return outcomeOf((await source.ingest(events))[0]);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof OfflineAcceptError) return outcomeOf(error.results[0]);
      return unreachable();
    }
  }

  export async function publishDraft(source: DataSource, make: MakeSubmitted, input: DraftInput): Promise<DraftOutcome> {
    let backlog: RankedRow[];
    try {
      backlog = await visibleBacklogRows(source, input.projectId);
    } catch {
      return unreachable();
    }
    return submit(source, publishEvents(make, { workspaceId: input.workspaceId, draft: input, backlog }));
  }

  export async function discardDraft(source: DataSource, make: MakeSubmitted, input: DraftInput): Promise<DraftOutcome> {
    return submit(source, [
      make({ workspaceId: input.workspaceId, entity: { kind: 'ticket', id: input.ticketId }, type: 'ticket.discarded', payload: {} }),
    ]);
  }
  ```
  `OfflineAcceptError.results[0]` is `pending` (queued) or a refusal the replica judged locally; both map through `outcomeOf`. Rerun: expected PASS. Commit.

  ```ts
  import { useEffect, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
  import type { DataSource } from '../data-source.js';
  import type { DraftRow } from '../view-types.js';
  import { useLiveQuery, type LiveQueryResult } from './use-live-query.js';

  /**
   * The drafts being saved, per workspace (drafts plan, Task 8, decision 5). The dialog adds a row before the server
   * answers; a refusal removes it; `useMyDrafts` drops it the moment the real list contains its id.
   */
  const rows = new Map<string, DraftRow[]>();
  const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  const NONE: readonly DraftRow[] = [];

  function publish(workspaceId: string, next: DraftRow[]): void {
    if (next.length === 0) rows.delete(workspaceId);
    else rows.set(workspaceId, next);
    for (const listener of [...listeners]) listener();
  }

  export function addPendingDraft(workspaceId: string, row: DraftRow): void {
    publish(workspaceId, [row, ...(rows.get(workspaceId) ?? []).filter((r) => r.ticketId !== row.ticketId)]);
  }

  export function removePendingDraft(workspaceId: string, ticketId: string): void {
    const current = rows.get(workspaceId);
    if (current === undefined || !current.some((r) => r.ticketId === ticketId)) return;
    publish(workspaceId, current.filter((r) => r.ticketId !== ticketId));
  }

  /** A stable reference until the workspace's rows change (a `useSyncExternalStore` snapshot). */
  export function pendingDraftsOf(workspaceId: string): readonly DraftRow[] {
    return rows.get(workspaceId) ?? NONE;
  }

  export function resetPendingDrafts(): void {
    rows.clear();
    for (const listener of [...listeners]) listener();
  }

  const subscribe = (listener: () => void): (() => void) => {
    listeners.add(listener);
    return () => { listeners.delete(listener); };
  };

  /** The server's list with the rows still being saved in front. `null` while the server has not answered. */
  export function mergeDrafts(server: readonly DraftRow[] | null, pending: readonly DraftRow[]): DraftRow[] | null {
    if (server === null) return null;
    const known = new Set(server.map((d) => d.ticketId));
    return [...pending.filter((d) => !known.has(d.ticketId)), ...server];
  }

  export function useMyDrafts(source: DataSource, workspaceId: string): LiveQueryResult<DraftRow[]> {
    const live = useLiveQuery(source, workspaceId, `${workspaceId}:drafts`, () => source.query.getMyDrafts(workspaceId), {
      cacheKey: `drafts:${workspaceId}`,
    });
    const pending = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => pendingDraftsOf(workspaceId), () => NONE);
    useEffect(() => {
      if (live.data === null) return;
      for (const draft of live.data) removePendingDraft(workspaceId, draft.ticketId);
    }, [live.data, workspaceId]);
    return { ...live, data: mergeDrafts(live.data, pending) };
  }
  ```

  `packages/app-core/src/views/discard-draft-dialog.tsx`:
  ```tsx
  import { useRef, type ReactElement } from 'react';
  import { Button, Dialog } from '@gisik-nokma/ui';
  import type { DiscardCounts } from './draft-actions.js';
  import {
    DISCARD_ATTACHMENTS_UNKNOWN, DISCARD_CONFIRM_LABEL, DISCARD_NOTES_LINE, DISCARD_QUESTION, attachmentsLine, subDraftsLine,
  } from './drafts-copy.js';

  /**
   * The Discard confirmation (spec §12.3, R60). Presentational: the host owns the submit, because the list erases a row
   * optimistically and the sheet closes itself, and neither wants a dialog that decides. Focus starts on Cancel, the safe
   * answer for a destructive confirm (`Dialog.initialFocusRef`, the trash series' precedent).
   */
  export function DiscardDraftDialog(props: {
    open: boolean;
    title: string;
    counts: DiscardCounts;
    onCancel: () => void;
    onConfirm: () => void;
  }): ReactElement | null {
    const cancelRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
    const { counts } = props;
    return (
      <Dialog open={props.open} title="Discard draft" role="alertdialog" onClose={props.onCancel} initialFocusRef={cancelRef}
        footer={<>
          <Button ref={cancelRef} onClick={props.onCancel}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="danger" onClick={props.onConfirm}>{DISCARD_CONFIRM_LABEL}</Button>
        </>}>
        <p>{DISCARD_QUESTION}</p>
        <p><strong>{props.title}</strong></p>
        <ul className="gn-discard-lines">
          {counts.subDrafts > 0 ? <li>{subDraftsLine(counts.subDrafts)}</li> : null}
          {counts.attachments === null ? <li>{DISCARD_ATTACHMENTS_UNKNOWN}</li> : counts.attachments > 0 ? <li>{attachmentsLine(counts.attachments)}</li> : null}
          <li>{DISCARD_NOTES_LINE}</li>
        </ul>
      </Dialog>
    );
  }
  ```
  (If `Button` has no `danger` variant, use the variant `DeleteDialog` gives its confirm; its import block at `delete-dialog.tsx:1-7` shows the same `Button, Dialog` pair. `.gn-discard-lines` is covered by Step 8's CSS.)

  `packages/app-core/src/views/drafts-list.tsx`:
  ```tsx
  import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactElement } from 'react';
  import { Chip } from '@gisik-nokma/ui';
  import type { DataSource } from '../data-source.js';
  import { makeSubmittedFactory } from '../submit.js';
  import type { DraftRow } from '../view-types.js';
  import { DiscardDraftDialog } from './discard-draft-dialog.js';
  import { discardCounts, discardDraft, publishDraft, subDraftsOf, type DraftOutcome } from './draft-actions.js';
  import {
    DRAFTS_EMPTY, DRAFTS_NAV_LABEL, DRAFT_DISCARD_LABEL, DRAFT_PENDING_LABEL, DRAFT_PUBLISH_LABEL, draftParentLabel,
  } from './drafts-copy.js';

  export type DraftsListProps = {
    drafts: readonly DraftRow[];
    dataSource: DataSource;
    workspaceId: string;
    currentUserId: string;
    typeName: (typeId: string) => string;
    /** The title of a parent that is not itself one of these drafts; `null` when unknown. */
    parentTitleOf?: (parentId: string) => string | null;
    phone?: boolean;
    onOpenTicket: (ticketId: string) => void;
    /** A publish or discard committed or was queued: the host re-reads the list. */
    onChanged?: () => void;
  };

  type Alert = { ticketId: string; text: string };

  export function DraftsList(props: DraftsListProps): ReactElement {
    const { drafts, dataSource, workspaceId, currentUserId } = props;
    const make = makeSubmittedFactory({ actorId: currentUserId, origin: 'web' });
    const [hidden, setHidden] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());
    const [alert, setAlert] = useState<Alert | null>(null);
    const [discarding, setDiscarding] = useState<DraftRow | null>(null);

    const hide = (ids: readonly string[]): void => setHidden((was) => new Set([...was, ...ids]));
    const show = (ids: readonly string[]): void => setHidden((was) => new Set([...was].filter((id) => !ids.includes(id))));

    /** One answer, one treatment: a commit or a queue asks the host to re-read; anything else puts the rows back. */
    const settle = (draft: DraftRow, ids: readonly string[], outcome: DraftOutcome): void => {
      if (outcome.status === 'committed' || outcome.status === 'queued') {
        if (outcome.status === 'queued') show(ids);
        props.onChanged?.();
        return;
      }
      show(ids);
      setAlert({ ticketId: draft.ticketId, text: outcome.status === 'refused' ? outcome.reason : outcome.message });
    };

    const publish = async (draft: DraftRow): Promise<void> => {
      setAlert(null);
      hide([draft.ticketId]);
      settle(draft, [draft.ticketId], await publishDraft(dataSource, make, { workspaceId, ticketId: draft.ticketId, projectId: draft.projectId }));
    };

    const confirmDiscard = async (draft: DraftRow): Promise<void> => {
      const ids = [draft.ticketId, ...subDraftsOf(drafts, draft.ticketId).map((d) => d.ticketId)];
      setDiscarding(null);
      setAlert(null);
      hide(ids);
      settle(draft, ids, await discardDraft(dataSource, make, { workspaceId, ticketId: draft.ticketId, projectId: draft.projectId }));
    };

    const visible = drafts.filter((d) => !hidden.has(d.ticketId));
    if (visible.length === 0 && alert === null) return <p className="gn-drafts__empty">{DRAFTS_EMPTY}</p>;

    const parentTitle = (draft: DraftRow): string | null =>
      draft.parentId === null ? null : (drafts.find((d) => d.ticketId === draft.parentId)?.title ?? props.parentTitleOf?.(draft.parentId) ?? null);

    return (
      <>
        <ul className="gn-drafts" aria-label={DRAFTS_NAV_LABEL}>
          {visible.map((draft) => {
            const parent = parentTitle(draft);
            return (
              <li key={draft.ticketId} className="gn-drafts__row">
                <Chip>{props.typeName(draft.typeId)}</Chip>
                <button type="button" className="gn-drafts__title" onClick={() => props.onOpenTicket(draft.ticketId)}>
                  <span className="gn-visually-hidden">Open </span>{draft.title}
                </button>
                <span className="gn-drafts__meta">
                  {draft.projectName === null ? null : <span>{draft.projectName}</span>}
                  {parent === null ? null : <span>{draftParentLabel(parent)}</span>}
                  {draft.pending ? <span>{DRAFT_PENDING_LABEL}</span> : null}
                </span>
                {props.phone === true ? (
                  <RowMenu title={draft.title} onPublish={() => void publish(draft)} onDiscard={() => setDiscarding(draft)} />
                ) : (
                  <span className="gn-drafts__actions">
                    <button type="button" className="gn-button gn-button--primary" aria-label={`${DRAFT_PUBLISH_LABEL} ${draft.title}`} onClick={() => void publish(draft)}>
                      {DRAFT_PUBLISH_LABEL}
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" className="gn-button gn-button--ghost" aria-label={`${DRAFT_DISCARD_LABEL} ${draft.title}`} onClick={() => setDiscarding(draft)}>
                      {DRAFT_DISCARD_LABEL}
                    </button>
                  </span>
                )}
                {alert?.ticketId === draft.ticketId ? <p role="alert" className="gn-drafts__alert">{alert.text}</p> : null}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
        {discarding === null ? null : (
          <DiscardDraftDialog open title={discarding.title} counts={discardCounts(drafts, discarding.ticketId)}
            onCancel={() => setDiscarding(null)} onConfirm={() => void confirmDiscard(discarding)} />
        )}
      </>
    );
  }

  /** The phone's row menu: one button, two items. Escape and a pick close it; focus returns to the button. */
  function RowMenu(props: { title: string; onPublish: () => void; onDiscard: () => void }): ReactElement {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const button = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
    useEffect(() => {
      if (!open) return;
      const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent): void => {
        if (event.key === 'Escape') { setOpen(false); button.current?.focus(); }
      };
      document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    }, [open]);
    const pick = (action: () => void) => (): void => { setOpen(false); action(); };
    return (
      <span className="gn-drafts__menu">
        <button ref={button} type="button" className="gn-button gn-button--ghost" aria-label={`Actions for ${props.title}`}
          aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen((was) => !was)}>
          &#8943;
        </button>
        {open ? (
          <div role="menu" className="gn-drafts__menu-list">
            <button type="button" role="menuitem" onClick={pick(props.onPublish)}>{DRAFT_PUBLISH_LABEL}</button>
            <button type="button" role="menuitem" onClick={pick(props.onDiscard)}>{DRAFT_DISCARD_LABEL}</button>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </span>
    );
  }
  ```
  An empty list that shows an alert keeps the `ul` out of the document: the first `if` returns the empty sentence only when nothing is visible AND no alert stands, so a refusal on the last row is not lost (the row it refers to is shown again by `show`, so in practice the alert always has its row).   The rule (spec R4, R42; owner ruling O1): no event on a published ticket's stream ever names a draft. The sheet's controls that write a relation are the Links section (typed-links T5, `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-03-typed-links.md:1580-1594`: `eventFor` files on the STORED source's stream) and Add subtask (`ticket-sheet.tsx:2591-2620` on the KG tip: `ticket.created { parentId: ticketId, start: 'focus' }` through `submitChildEvent`). On a draft's sheet both would file a public event naming the draft, which T5/T6 now refuse (`draft.link-form`, `hierarchy.unknown-parent`). No control on the KG tip reparents an EXISTING ticket (`git grep "'ticket.reparented'" packages/app-core/src apps/web` names no view), so the set-parent half is the pure `placeUnderEvent`, which every later parent control must use.

  RED first, `packages/app-core/test/views/draft-side-filing.test.tsx` (copy the `Harness` of `ticket-links-section.test.tsx` and the `renderSheet` helper used by `ticket-sheet-draft.test.tsx`):
  ```tsx
  /** Case 28.173, the draft-side clause (planner ruling A). */
  const D = '01JDRAFT00000000000000000D'; const S = '01JPUBLIC0000000000000000S'; const C = '01JCHILD00000000000000000C'; const P = '01JPARENT0000000000000000P';
  // `ingested` is `SubmittedEvent[][]`, one array per `ingest` call (`fake-data-source.ts:7`), so every read flattens it.
  const entities = (source: FakeDataSource) => source.ingested.flat().map((e) => e.entity.id);
  // `createFakeDataSource(overrides, ingestScript)`: the ingest answer is the SECOND argument, not a query override.
  const committing = () => createFakeDataSource({}, (events) => events.map(() => committed));

  describe('28.173 draft-side filing', () => {
    it('28.173 a draft sheet files links and parents on the draft\'s stream only; control: a published sheet files normally', async () => {
      // Draft sheet: "Blocked by S" (stored source S), then remove it.
      const draft = committing();
      const { user } = renderLinks({ source: draft, ticketId: D, isDraft: true, pick: S });
      await addLink(user, 'Blocked by', 'S-1');
      await removeLink(user, 'Blocked by', 'S-1');
      expect(draft.ingested.flat().map((e) => [e.entity.id, e.type, e.payload])).toEqual([
        [D, 'ticket.link_added', { kind: 'blocks', targetId: D, from: S }],
        [D, 'ticket.link_removed', { kind: 'blocks', targetId: D, from: S }],
      ]);
      expect(entities(draft)).not.toContain(S); // the other ticket's stream gets no event
      // Set a parent: a published C under the draft D, and Add subtask on the draft's sheet.
      expect(placeUnderEvent(make, WS, { parentId: D, parentIsDraft: true, childId: C })).toMatchObject({ entity: { kind: 'ticket', id: D }, type: 'ticket.reparented', payload: { newParentId: D, childId: C } });
      const sheet = committing();
      await addSubtaskOn(renderSheet({ source: sheet, read: draftRead({ id: D }) }), 'Pour the base');
      const child = sheet.ingested.flat().at(-1)!;
      expect(child).toMatchObject({ type: 'ticket.created', payload: { draft: true, start: 'backlog', parentId: D } });
      expect(child.entity.id).not.toBe(D);
      // The exact key set (the old `not.toHaveProperty('stateId')` could not fail: `addSubtask` never sends a stateId).
      expect(Object.keys(child.payload as object).sort()).toEqual(['draft', 'parentId', 'projectId', 'start', 'title', 'typeId']);

      // CONTROL: the same three actions on a published sheet file normally.
      const pub = committing();
      const { user: u2 } = renderLinks({ source: pub, ticketId: P, isDraft: false, pick: S });
      await addLink(u2, 'Blocked by', 'S-1');
      await removeLink(u2, 'Blocked by', 'S-1');
      expect(pub.ingested.flat().map((e) => [e.entity.id, e.type, e.payload])).toEqual([
        [S, 'ticket.link_added', { kind: 'blocks', targetId: P }],
        [S, 'ticket.link_removed', { kind: 'blocks', targetId: P }],

    ```ts
    function eventFor(make: MakeSubmitted, workspaceId: string, thisId: string, otherId: string,
                      kind: TicketLinkKind, onOther: boolean, type: 'ticket.link_added' | 'ticket.link_removed', isDraft = false) {
      // Planner ruling A / spec R42: on a draft's sheet a link whose stored source is the OTHER ticket is filed on
      // THIS draft's stream with `from`; no public stream names a draft (owner ruling O1).
      if (isDraft && onOther) return make({ workspaceId, entity: { kind: 'ticket', id: thisId }, type, payload: { kind, targetId: thisId, from: otherId } });
      const [source, target] = onOther ? [otherId, thisId] : [thisId, otherId];
      return make({ workspaceId, entity: { kind: 'ticket', id: source }, type, payload: { kind, targetId: target } });
    }
    ```

    ```ts
    /** Planner ruling A: the one way the app places a ticket under a parent. A draft parent holds a published child on
     *  ITS OWN stream (`childId`, spec R4, T6 Step 5a); the child's stream never names a draft. */
    export function placeUnderEvent(make: MakeSubmitted, workspaceId: string, p: { parentId: string; parentIsDraft: boolean; childId: string }): SubmittedEvent {
      return p.parentIsDraft
        ? make({ workspaceId, entity: { kind: 'ticket', id: p.parentId }, type: 'ticket.reparented', payload: { newParentId: p.parentId, childId: p.childId } })
        : make({ workspaceId, entity: { kind: 'ticket', id: p.childId }, type: 'ticket.reparented', payload: { newParentId: p.parentId } });
    }
    ```

  ```tsx
  'use client';

  import Link from 'next/link';
  import type { AriaAttributes } from 'react';
  import { DRAFTS_NAV_LABEL, draftsNavName, useMyDrafts } from '@gisik-nokma/app-core';
  import { NavPending } from './nav-pending.js';
  import { useAppServices, useSessionStatus } from './providers.js';

  /**
   * The Drafts entry (drafts plan, Task 8, spec §12.2): beside My work, with the count of the viewer's own drafts in this
   * workspace. The read is gated on a session for the reason `InboxNavLink` states: the nav renders on pages a signed-out
   * viewer can reach, and an ungated read there is a 401 on a timer. The count lives in the accessible name too (a number
   * drawn only in a badge is colour and shape alone).
   */
  export function DraftsNavLink({ workspaceId, current }: { workspaceId: string; current?: AriaAttributes['aria-current'] }) {
    const session = useSessionStatus();
    return session.kind === 'signed-in' ? (
      <CountedDraftsLink workspaceId={workspaceId} current={current} />
    ) : (
      <Link href={`/w/${workspaceId}/drafts`} aria-current={current}><NavPending>{DRAFTS_NAV_LABEL}</NavPending></Link>
    );
  }

  function CountedDraftsLink({ workspaceId, current }: { workspaceId: string; current?: AriaAttributes['aria-current'] }) {
    const { dataSource } = useAppServices();
    const count = useMyDrafts(dataSource, workspaceId).data?.length ?? 0;
    return (
      <Link href={`/w/${workspaceId}/drafts`} aria-current={current} aria-label={draftsNavName(count)}>
        <NavPending>{DRAFTS_NAV_LABEL}</NavPending>
        {count > 0 ? <span className="gn-nav__count" aria-hidden="true">{count > 99 ? '99+' : count}</span> : null}
      </Link>
    );
  }
  ```

  ```tsx
  'use client';

  import { Suspense, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
  import { useParams, useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
  import { DraftsList, TicketSheet, useLiveQuery, useMyDrafts } from '@gisik-nokma/app-core';
  import { AppNav } from '../../../../src/app-nav.js';
  import { ListPageShell } from '../../../../src/skeletons/page-shells.js';
  import { ShellRefusal } from '../../../../src/shell-refusal.js';
  import { ExpiredSessionNotice, useSignInOnExpiredSession } from '../../../../src/expired-session.js';
  import { TicketEditorSlot, uploadAttachmentHttp } from '../../../../src/editor-slot.js';
  import { peopleProps } from '../../../../src/people-props.js';
  import { useAppServices, useSessionStatus } from '../../../../src/providers.js';
  import { useCanModerateComments } from '../../../../src/use-can-moderate-comments.js';
  import { useIsPhone } from '../../../../src/use-is-phone.js';
  import { useProjectName } from '../../../../src/use-project-name.js';
  import { useWorkspaceName } from '../../../../src/use-workspace-name.js';
  import { buildProjectPageQueryTickets, ticketRefHrefIn } from '../../../../src/ticket-ref-callbacks.js';

  export default function DraftsPage() {
    return (
      <Suspense fallback={<ListPageShell title="Drafts" rows={5} />}>
        <DraftsScreen />
      </Suspense>
    );
  }

  /**
   * The viewer's own drafts (drafts plan, Task 8, spec §12.2). The sheet opens HERE, in place, like My work's: the open
   * ticket is `?ticket=`, and its project is read off the draft's own row, never guessed. A `?ticket=` the list does not
   * hold mounts nothing: the locator would answer the not-found answer for someone else's draft, and a draft is nobody's but its author's.
   */
  function DraftsScreen() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { workspaceId } = useParams<{ workspaceId: string }>();
    const searchParams = useSearchParams();
    const { dataSource, cache, people } = useAppServices();
    const session = useSessionStatus();
    const currentUserId = session.kind === 'signed-in' ? session.user.id : '';
    const canModerateComments = useCanModerateComments(workspaceId);
    const phone = useIsPhone();
    const drafts = useMyDrafts(dataSource, workspaceId);
    const types = useLiveQuery(dataSource, workspaceId, `${workspaceId}:ticket-types`, () => dataSource.query.getTicketTypes(workspaceId), {
      cacheKey: `types:${workspaceId}`,
    });
    const expired = useSignInOnExpiredSession([drafts.error]);
    const workspaceName = useWorkspaceName(workspaceId);

    const openTicketId = searchParams.get('ticket');
    const openRow = openTicketId === null ? undefined : drafts.data?.find((d) => d.ticketId === openTicketId);
    const projectName = useProjectName(workspaceId, openRow?.projectId);
    const attachments = useLiveQuery(dataSource, workspaceId, `${openTicketId ?? 'none'}:attachments`, async () =>
      openTicketId === null ? [] : dataSource.query.getTicketAttachments(workspaceId, openTicketId),
    );

    // The title of a parent that is not one of these drafts (a published parent), read once per distinct parent.
    const [parentTitles, setParentTitles] = useState<ReadonlyMap<string, string>>(new Map());
    useEffect(() => {
      const listed = new Set((drafts.data ?? []).map((d) => d.ticketId));
      const wanted = [...new Set((drafts.data ?? []).flatMap((d) => (d.parentId === null || listed.has(d.parentId) || parentTitles.has(d.parentId) ? [] : [d.parentId])))];
      for (const id of wanted) {
        void dataSource.query.getTicket(workspaceId, id).then((read) => {
          if (read !== null) setParentTitles((was) => new Map(was).set(id, read.title));
        }, () => undefined);
      }
    }, [drafts.data, parentTitles, dataSource, workspaceId]);

    const typeName = (typeId: string): string => types.data?.find((t) => t.id === typeId)?.name ?? typeId;
    const openTicket = (ticketId: string) => router.push(`/w/${workspaceId}/drafts?ticket=${ticketId}`, { scroll: false });
    const closeTicket = () => router.push(`/w/${workspaceId}/drafts`, { scroll: false });

    return (
      <main id="gn-main" className="gn-shell">
        <AppNav workspaceId={workspaceId} />
        <h1 className="gn-page-title">Drafts</h1>
        <div className="gn-shell__main">
          {expired ? (
            <ExpiredSessionNotice />
          ) : drafts.error !== null ? (
            <ShellRefusal what="Drafts" message={drafts.error} />
          ) : drafts.data === null ? (
            <ListPageShell title="Drafts" rows={5} />
          ) : (
            <DraftsList
              drafts={drafts.data}
              dataSource={dataSource}
              workspaceId={workspaceId}
              currentUserId={currentUserId}
              typeName={typeName}
              parentTitleOf={(id) => parentTitles.get(id) ?? null}
              phone={phone}
              onOpenTicket={openTicket}
              onChanged={drafts.reload}
            />
          )}
        </div>
        {openTicketId !== null && openRow !== undefined && !expired ? (
          <TicketSheet
            {...peopleProps(people, workspaceId)}
            dataSource={dataSource}
            cache={cache}
            workspaceId={workspaceId}
            ticketId={openTicketId}
            currentUserId={currentUserId}
            canModerateComments={canModerateComments}
            attachments={attachments.data ?? undefined}
            attachmentsUnavailable={attachments.error ?? undefined}
            onClose={closeTicket}
            editorSlot={TicketEditorSlot}
            queryTickets={buildProjectPageQueryTickets(dataSource, workspaceId, openRow.projectId)}
            resolveTicketHref={ticketRefHrefIn(workspaceId)}
            workspaceName={workspaceName}
            projectName={projectName}
            workspaceHref={`/w/${workspaceId}`}
            projectHref={`/w/${workspaceId}/p/${openRow.projectId}`}
            onNavigate={(href) => router.push(href, { scroll: true })}
            uploadEvidence={(file: File) => uploadAttachmentHttp(file, openTicketId)}
            uploadAttachment={(file: File) => uploadAttachmentHttp(file, openTicketId)}
            onOpenTicket={openTicket}
            onDraftChanged={drafts.reload}
          />
        ) : null}
      </main>
    );
  }
  ```

**Decisions the code forced, stated so a reviewer does not reopen them.**
1. **G10 is two questions at every door: `canOpen`, then `ticketIsOpenable`.** `ticketIsLive` asks `LIVE_TICKET_WHERE`, which T3 closed on `draft_author_id`, so left in place it would 404 the author's own upload. `ticketIsOpenable` asks `LIVE_BASE_WHERE` (deleted ticket, deleted project) and nothing about drafts; it is only ever called after `canOpen`, so a draft is never reachable by someone else through it. For a published ticket the two functions are the same query, so no existing case moves. `ticketIsLive` stays at the comments door.
2. **`note.created {attachTicketId}` naming a draft stays refused.** The spec's census table (`drafts-design.md:228`) lists the create-with-ticket gate (`check-permission.ts:1573`) as a door, but G11 (`:269`) and R66 name only the `note.attached` / `note.detached` gate (`:1602`). Opening the create gate cannot be made safe by `noteEventVisibleTo`: the creation event is the one every reader of the note needs, and withholding it would hide the note itself. So the app creates the note first and attaches second (two events), and an `inherit` note, which needs `attachTicketId` at birth, cannot be born on a draft. 28.191 pins the refusal as a control.
3. **One helper answers "is this ticket withheld from this person": `isClosedOrErasedDraft` (renamed from `isClosedDraft`, planner ruling 2026-10-04, T9-Q1; narrowed and renamed again, planner ruling 2026-10-04, follow-up).** It is true for another person's draft, for the author's own draft after they lost the right to create in its project (R18), for a discarded draft not yet erased, and for an ERASED draft: an id with no `proj_tickets` row whose ledger still holds a redacted `ticket.created` saying `draft: true` and holds no `ticket.published`. It is false for a published ticket, a soft-deleted one included (its row stays), and for a published ticket the trash purge erased. **Why that marker (verified on the ref, planner ruling 2026-10-04, follow-up):** discard and purge leave the SAME kind of remains, so "no row and no surviving `ticket.created`" separates nothing. `discardDraft` is `purgeItem` with the discard gate (`purge/discard-draft.ts:40`), and `purgeItem` calls `purge_ledger` (`purge/purge-item.ts:142-145`). For a ticket, `purge_ledger` (`migrations/1791600000000_drafts.sql:51-64`) keeps every `ticket.created` and `ticket.published` row, redacted: a creation that said `draft: true` keeps `{projectId, purged: true, draft: true}` (`:54-55`), any other keeps `{projectId, purged: true}` (`:56`), and a `ticket.published` keeps `{projectId, purged: true}` (`:60`). It deletes every other event (`:61-64`), the `ticket.discarded` included. So an erased draft leaves a `draft: true` creation and no publish; a purged ticket that was born published leaves a creation without `draft`; and a purged ticket that was born a draft and then published leaves a `draft: true` creation AND a redacted publish. Only the first is withheld. `noteEventVisibleTo` uses it for `note.attached` / `note.detached`, and the ticket's notes list (`GET .../tickets/:ticketId/notes`, which never asked about the ticket at all) uses it to answer `{ notes: [] }`, the shape it already gives an unknown id. Corrected (planner ruling 2026-10-04, the owner's no-trace ruling; this sentence said the event was then delivered): after the erasure the event names an erased draft, and it stays WITHHELD, from every reader, the author included: discard erases everything, links included, and an attach that was withheld must not surface once its ticket is gone. A purged PUBLISHED ticket's attaches are still delivered, as today (planner ruling 2026-10-04, follow-up). The doors that deliver note events, each asking `noteEventVisibleTo` (on the ref): the stream's note arm (`visibility/visible-events-for.ts:726`, after `canReadNote`), the note's events read, the "history" a device pulls (`routes/notes.ts:167-185`, `GET /v1/notes/:noteId/events`), and the bootstrap notes tail (`sync/sync-routes.ts:529-542`). `GET /v1/notes/:noteId/history` (`routes/notes.ts:118-129`) needs no filter: `listNoteHistory` (`read/notes.ts:324-335`) selects only `note.created` and `note.body_set`. The other ledger reads of note events (`notifications/fanout.ts:225`, `projections/notes.ts:240`) deliver nothing to a reader. (QUESTION T9-Q1-P is ruled, planner ruling 2026-10-04, follow-up: the plain no-row test would also have withheld a purged published ticket's attaches; the ledger marker above does not.)
4. **Publish names the linked notes of ANY scope, for the published ticket itself.** `notesAttachedTo` returned `inherit` notes only, because the trigger events it served (`visibility.set`, `ticket.reparented`, `ticket.assigned`) widen an `inherit` note's audience and nothing else. A publish is different: the withheld `note.attached` sits on the stream of a `workspace`, `project` or `explicit` note too, and its readers need it. The any-scope read is made for the trigger ticket only (`[env.entity.id]`), the inherit read stays for the whole dependent set, and `noteGrantNoticeFor`'s `canReadNote` still decides who is told (28.194 has a note the admin cannot read).
5. **The accepted limit (Q16), stated as a fact for the report.** The notice carries `headSeq`, the note's last event at or below the reader's cursor, and the client pulls only when its local head is below it. A reader who received a LATER event of the same note (a `note.body_set` after the attach) before the publish has a local head at or above `headSeq`, so the withheld attach is not re-pulled: their replica does not list the note under the ticket until the next full bootstrap or reconcile. The server reads (`attachedTickets`, the ticket's notes list) are right at once.
6. **The rank events follow ALL the publishes, in one transaction.** Per project, in order of first appearance in the set: the backfill, then the set's tickets in the given order. They come after every `ticket.published` so T5b's pin that the publishes take consecutive ledger rows (28.103) holds, and they are the same transaction, so a refused rank (a Backlog row a concurrent move took out of the Backlog) rolls back the publishes too and the 409 names the ranked ticket as `ticketId`. The rows are read before the transaction, with the staleness a drag has.
7. **`planTailRank(rows, tailIds)` adds a second parameter to the name p0 fixed.** "Place these last" needs to know which ids; a one-parameter form would have to guess the published ticket from an unranked row. `planRankMove` keeps its signature and now draws its backfill from the same `backfillUnranked`, so there is one implementation of "where do unranked rows go" (the thing `backlog-rank.ts` warns about drifting), and 28.192 pins the two against each other.
8. **The ranked set is the publisher's visible Backlog, every ticket of the project** (R65, Q15), not only roots: `ticket.ranked` is a per-ticket claim and the Backlog tab's rows are exactly the visible Backlog tickets. A row the publisher cannot see keeps no key and draws below the new ticket for those who can (28.189).
9. **A linked note's search text changes at publish.** `note-search.ts` derives `ticket_text` from `LIVE_TICKET_WHERE` tickets and re-derives on `ticket.field_set` (title), `ticket.deleted` and `ticket.restored`; a ticket that was a draft while the note was linked has no line, and nothing re-derived it when it became live. `ticket.published` joins the list (28.194).
10. **Discard needs no new erase code.** R58 to R59 are `objectKeysOf`, the `attachments` delete, `purge_pending_objects`, the drain and the survivors path T5 and the trash series already run; 28.183 to 28.185 are characterisation tests and are GREEN on first run. Their RED is the mutation list in the last step.

**What the author can do after this task.** Attach files to a draft (upload, list, download, record with `attachment.added`), link their own notes to it, and see none of it from anyone else; publish it and have the attachments and notes appear for the readers; discard it and have the files and links go while the notes stay; and a published draft, singly from the app or in a set from the route, draws at the END of its project's Backlog.

  `apps/server/test/helpers/door.ts` (new):
  ```ts
  import { newUlid, type EntityKind } from '@gisik-nokma/domain';
  import type { ReadRole, ReadWorld } from './read-app.js';
  import { SCENARIO_NOW } from './read-scenario.js';

  export type DoorResult = { status: string; rule?: string; reason?: string };

  /** One event through `POST /v1/events` as `role`: the real gate, the real engine, the real projections. */
  export async function door(
    read: ReadWorld,
    role: ReadRole,
    kind: EntityKind,
    id: string,
    type: string,
    payload: unknown,
  ): Promise<DoorResult> {
    const res = await read.app.inject({
      method: 'POST',
      url: '/v1/events',
      headers: read.authOf(role),
      payload: {
        events: [
          {
            id: newUlid(),
            workspaceId: read.world.workspaceId,
            entity: { kind, id },
            type,
            version: 1,
            payload,
            actorId: read.userIds[role],
            origin: 'web',
            clientTime: SCENARIO_NOW.toISOString(),
          },
        ],
      },
    });
    if (res.statusCode !== 200) throw new Error(`POST /v1/events answered ${res.statusCode}: ${res.body}`);
    const result = (res.json() as { results: DoorResult[] }).results[0];
    // Only the three fields a case compares: the event id differs on every call, so two refusals can be `toEqual`.
    return { status: result?.status ?? 'missing', rule: result?.rule, reason: result?.reason };
  }

  /** Real magic bytes: sixteen bytes of a PNG header are enough for the server's sniffer. */
  export const PNG = Buffer.from([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0d, 0x49, 0x48, 0x44, 0x52]);

  /** `POST /v1/attachments` naming `ticketId`, as `role`. */
  export function uploadFile(read: ReadWorld, role: ReadRole, ticketId: string, filename = 'photo.png') {
    const boundary = 'gisik-draft-boundary';
    const payload = Buffer.concat([
      Buffer.from(`--${boundary}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="ticketId"\r\n\r\n${ticketId}\r\n`),
      Buffer.from(
        `--${boundary}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="${filename}"\r\nContent-Type: image/png\r\n\r\n`,
      ),
      PNG,
      Buffer.from(`\r\n--${boundary}--\r\n`),
    ]);
    return read.app.inject({
      method: 'POST',
      url: '/v1/attachments',
      payload,
      headers: { ...read.authOf(role), 'content-type': `multipart/form-data; boundary=${boundary}` },
    });
  }
  ```

  import { mkdtemp, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';

  import { join } from 'node:path';

  import { buildProjectionRegistry } from '../../src/projections/index.js';

  import { deletePendingObjects } from '../../src/purge/pending-objects.js';
  import { verifyProjections } from '../../src/tools/verify-projections.js';
  import { applyCommitted, resetEntitySeqs } from '../helpers/apply.js';
  import { createTestDatabase, type TestDatabase } from '../helpers/db.js';
  import { doc, ev, insertAttachment, noteCreated, projectCreated, recordingStore, seedWorkspace, text, TYPE_ID, ticketCreated, type Base } from './world.js';

  /** Drafts T9: what a discard does to the attachments uploaded from the draft and to the notes linked to it (28.183 to 28.185). */
  const AUTHOR = newUlid();
  const NOW = new Date('2026-10-04T06:00:00.000Z');

  type World = Base & {
    P: string; D: string; C: string; PUB: string; N: string;
    keys: { d: string; c: string; pub: string; n: string };
    noteTitle: string;
  };

  /** A draft D with a sub-draft C and an attachment each, a published ticket PUB with one, and a note N linked to D with its own attachment. */
  async function build(db: TestDatabase): Promise<World> {
    const base = await seedWorkspace(db.pool);
    const [P, D, C, PUB, N] = [newUlid(), newUlid(), newUlid(), newUlid(), newUlid()];
    const ids = { d: newUlid(), c: newUlid(), pub: newUlid(), n: newUlid() };
    const keys = {
      d: `w/${base.WS}/a/${ids.d}`, c: `w/${base.WS}/a/${ids.c}`, pub: `w/${base.WS}/a/${ids.pub}`, n: `w/${base.WS}/a/${ids.n}`,
    };
    const noteTitle = `Linked minutes ${newUlid().slice(-8)}`;
    const draft = (id: string, parentId: string | null, title: string) =>
      ev(base, 'ticket', id, 'ticket.created', { typeId: TYPE_ID, projectId: P, parentId, title, start: 'backlog', draft: true }, AUTHOR);
    await applyCommitted(db.pool, [
      projectCreated(base, P, 'Drafts', 'DR'),
      ticketCreated(base, PUB, P, 'Published control'),
      draft(D, null, 'Quokka draft'),
      draft(C, D, 'Quokka sub-draft'),
      noteCreated(base, N, { title: noteTitle, homeProjectId: '', scope: { mode: 'workspace' }, body: doc(text('the note body survives')) }),
      ev(base, 'note', N, 'note.attached', { ticketId: D }),
    ]);
    await insertAttachment(db.pool, base, ids.d, { ticketId: D }, 'draft.pdf', keys.d);
    await insertAttachment(db.pool, base, ids.c, { ticketId: C }, 'sub-draft.pdf', keys.c);
    await insertAttachment(db.pool, base, ids.pub, { ticketId: PUB }, 'published.pdf', keys.pub);
    await insertAttachment(db.pool, base, ids.n, { noteId: N }, 'note.pdf', keys.n);
    await applyCommitted(db.pool, [ev(base, 'ticket', D, 'ticket.discarded', {}, AUTHOR)]);
    return { ...base, P, D, C, PUB, N, keys, noteTitle };
  }

  async function putAll(store: LocalDiskStore, keys: string[]): Promise<void> {
    for (const key of keys) await store.put(key, Readable.from(Buffer.from('bytes')), { mime: 'application/pdf', size: 5 });
  }
  async function stored(store: LocalDiskStore, key: string): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      (await store.getStream(key)).destroy();
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof ObjectNotFoundError) return false;
      throw error;
    }
  }
  const objectKeys = async (db: TestDatabase, ws: string): Promise<string[]> =>
    (await db.pool.query<{ object_key: string }>('SELECT object_key FROM attachments WHERE workspace_id = $1 ORDER BY object_key', [ws])).rows.map((r) => r.object_key);

  let shared: TestDatabase;
  let storeRoot = '';
  beforeAll(async () => {
    resetEntitySeqs();
    shared = await createTestDatabase();
    storeRoot = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'gisik-draft-purge-'));
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await rm(storeRoot, { recursive: true, force: true });
    await shared.drop();
  });

  describe('28.183 discard erases what came from the draft', () => {
    it('removes the rows and the objects of the draft and its sub-draft; the published ticket\'s attachment and the note\'s own attachment keep both', async () => {
      const w = await build(shared);
      const store = new LocalDiskStore(join(storeRoot, 'a'));
      const all = [w.keys.d, w.keys.c, w.keys.pub, w.keys.n];
      await putAll(store, all);
      for (const key of all) expect(await stored(store, key), key).toBe(true); // CONTROL: every object is there to be erased
      expect(await objectKeys(shared, w.WS)).toEqual([...all].sort());

      const outcome = await discardDraft(shared.pool, w.D, { projections: buildProjectionRegistry(), store, now: NOW });
      expect(outcome).toMatchObject({ status: 'purged' });

      expect(await objectKeys(shared, w.WS)).toEqual([w.keys.n, w.keys.pub].sort());
      expect(await stored(store, w.keys.d)).toBe(false);
      expect(await stored(store, w.keys.c)).toBe(false);
      expect(await stored(store, w.keys.pub)).toBe(true);
      expect(await stored(store, w.keys.n)).toBe(true);
      const queued = await shared.pool.query('SELECT 1 FROM purge_pending_objects WHERE object_key = ANY($1)', [all]);
      expect(queued.rows).toHaveLength(0);
    });
  });

  describe('28.184 a store that throws on delete', () => {
    it('leaves the key queued with its error and one attempt, deletes the other, and a later drain empties the queue', async () => {
      const w = await build(shared);
      const failing = recordingStore(new Set([w.keys.d]));
      const outcome = await discardDraft(shared.pool, w.D, { projections: buildProjectionRegistry(), store: failing, now: NOW });
      expect(outcome).toMatchObject({ status: 'purged' });

      expect(await objectKeys(shared, w.WS)).toEqual([w.keys.n, w.keys.pub].sort()); // the rows are gone whatever the store did
      expect(failing.deleted).toEqual([w.keys.c]);
      const { rows } = await shared.pool.query<{ object_key: string; attempts: number; last_error: string }>(
        'SELECT object_key, attempts, last_error FROM purge_pending_objects WHERE object_key = ANY($1)',
        [[w.keys.d, w.keys.c]],
      );
      expect(rows).toEqual([{ object_key: w.keys.d, attempts: 1, last_error: `boom: ${w.keys.d}` }]);

      const working = recordingStore();
      expect(await deletePendingObjects(shared.pool, working, [w.keys.d])).toEqual({ deleted: 1, pending: 0 });
      expect(working.deleted).toEqual([w.keys.d]);
      expect((await shared.pool.query('SELECT 1 FROM purge_pending_objects WHERE object_key = $1', [w.keys.d])).rows).toHaveLength(0);
      expect(await deletePendingObjects(shared.pool, working, [w.keys.d])).toEqual({ deleted: 0, pending: 0 }); // CONTROL: nothing left to do
    });
  });

  describe('28.185 a linked note survives', () => {

      const link = () => shared.pool.query('SELECT 1 FROM proj_note_attachments WHERE note_id = $1 AND ticket_id = $2', [w.N, w.D]);
      expect((await link()).rows).toHaveLength(1); // CONTROL: the link existed

      await discardDraft(shared.pool, w.D, { projections: buildProjectionRegistry(), store: recordingStore(), now: NOW });

      expect((await link()).rows).toHaveLength(0);
      const note = await shared.pool.query<{ title: string; body: unknown }>('SELECT title, body FROM proj_notes WHERE note_id = $1', [w.N]);
      expect(note.rows).toEqual([{ title: w.noteTitle, body: doc(text('the note body survives')) }]);
      expect((await shared.pool.query('SELECT 1 FROM attachments WHERE note_id = $1', [w.N])).rows).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(await verifyProjections({ pool: shared.pool, projections: buildProjectionRegistry() })).toEqual({ clean: true, diffs: [] });
    });
  });

  import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
  import { compareByRank, newUlid, planTailRank, type RankAssignment } from '@gisik-nokma/domain';
  import { door } from '../helpers/door.js';
  import { createTestDatabase, type TestDatabase } from '../helpers/db.js';
  import { buildReadTestApp, type ReadRole, type ReadWorld } from '../helpers/read-app.js';

  let db: TestDatabase;
  let read: ReadWorld;
  beforeAll(async () => {
    db = await createTestDatabase();
    read = await buildReadTestApp(db);
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await read.app.close();
    await db.drop();
  });

  const WS = (): string => read.world.workspaceId;

  /** A project of its own, so its Backlog is exactly what the test makes. Every owner, admin and member is on a founded project. */
  async function project(): Promise<string> {
    const id = newUlid();
    expect(await door(read, 'owner', 'project', id, 'project.created', { name: `Rank ${id.slice(-6)}` })).toMatchObject({ status: 'committed' });
    return id;
  }
  async function backlog(projectId: string, role: ReadRole = 'member'): Promise<string> {
    const id = newUlid();
    expect(
      await door(read, role, 'ticket', id, 'ticket.created', { typeId: 'task', projectId, parentId: null, title: `Row ${id.slice(-6)}`, start: 'backlog' }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 'committed' });
    return id;
  }
  async function draft(projectId: string, role: ReadRole = 'member'): Promise<string> {
    const id = newUlid();
    expect(
      await door(read, role, 'ticket', id, 'ticket.created', { typeId: 'task', projectId, parentId: null, title: `Draft ${id.slice(-6)}`, start: 'backlog', draft: true }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 'committed' });
    return id;
  }
  const rank = async (id: string, key: string) => expect(await door(read, 'member', 'ticket', id, 'ticket.ranked', { rank: key })).toMatchObject({ status: 'committed' });

  async function rowsOf(projectId: string): Promise<Array<{ ticketId: string; rank: string | null }>> {
    const { rows } = await db.pool.query<{ ticket_id: string; rank: string | null }>(
      `SELECT ticket_id, rank FROM proj_tickets
        WHERE project_id = $1 AND state_id = 'backlog' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND draft_author_id IS NULL`,
      [projectId],
    );
    return rows.map((row) => ({ ticketId: row.ticket_id, rank: row.rank }));
  }
  const drawn = async (projectId: string): Promise<string[]> => (await rowsOf(projectId)).sort(compareByRank).map((row) => row.ticketId);
  const publishSet = (role: ReadRole, ticketIds: string[]) =>
    read.app.inject({ method: 'POST', url: `/v1/workspaces/${WS()}/drafts/publish`, headers: read.authOf(role), payload: { ticketIds } });
  const head = async (): Promise<number> =>
    Number((await db.pool.query<{ head: string }>('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(workspace_seq), 0) AS head FROM events WHERE workspace_id = $1', [WS()])).rows[0]?.head);
  const writtenSince = async (seq: number): Promise<Array<{ type: string; entity_id: string }>> =>
    (
      await db.pool.query<{ type: string; entity_id: string }>(
        `SELECT type, entity_id FROM events WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND workspace_seq > $2 AND type IN ('ticket.published', 'ticket.ranked') ORDER BY workspace_seq`,
        [WS(), seq],
      )
    ).rows;

  describe('28.187 rank on publish, single (R64)', () => {
    it('lands the ticket last and keeps the unranked rows in their old order; CONTROL: the tail key alone draws above them', async () => {
      const p = await project();
      const [r1, r2, u1, u2] = [await backlog(p), await backlog(p), await backlog(p), await backlog(p)];
      await rank(r1, 'g');
      await rank(r2, 'p');
      const d = await draft(p);
      const before = await drawn(p);
      expect(before.slice(0, 2)).toEqual([r1, r2]);

      expect(await door(read, 'member', 'ticket', d, 'ticket.published', { projectId: p })).toMatchObject({ status: 'committed' });
      const rows = await rowsOf(p);
      const plan = planTailRank(rows, [d]);
      expect(plan.backfill.map((a) => a.ticketId)).toEqual(before.filter((id) => id === u1 || id === u2));
      expect(plan.tail.map((a) => a.ticketId)).toEqual([d]);

      const draws = (assignments: RankAssignment[]): string[] => {
        const keys = new Map(assignments.map((a) => [a.ticketId, a.rank]));
        return rows.map((row) => ({ ...row, rank: keys.get(row.ticketId) ?? row.rank })).sort(compareByRank).map((row) => row.ticketId);
      };
      expect(draws(plan.tail).indexOf(d)).toBeLessThan(draws(plan.tail).indexOf(u1)); // CONTROL: no backfill, d above the unranked rows

      for (const assignment of [...plan.backfill, ...plan.tail]) {
        expect(await door(read, 'member', 'ticket', assignment.ticketId, 'ticket.ranked', { rank: assignment.rank })).toMatchObject({ status: 'committed' });
      }
      expect(await drawn(p)).toEqual([...before, d]);
    });
  });

  describe('28.188 rank on publish, a set (R64)', () => {
    it('writes the publishes, then per project the backfill and the set in the given order; each project draws the set last; one backfill per unranked row', async () => {
      const [pa, pb] = [await project(), await project()];
      const [ra, ua, ub] = [await backlog(pa), await backlog(pa), await backlog(pb)];
      await rank(ra, 'g');
      // Sorted DESCENDING into (a1, a2), so the given order [a1, …, a2] is not the ULID order (`newUlid` is not monotonic
      // inside a millisecond): a tail that sorted its ids would place a2 first.
      const [a2, a1] = [await draft(pa), await draft(pa)].sort();
      const b1 = await draft(pb);
      const [beforeA, beforeB, mark] = [await drawn(pa), await drawn(pb), await head()];

      const res = await publishSet('member', [a1, b1, a2]);
      expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(200);
      const written = await writtenSince(mark);
      expect(written.map((w) => w.type)).toEqual([...Array(3).fill('ticket.published'), ...Array(5).fill('ticket.ranked')]);
      expect(written.slice(0, 3).map((w) => w.entity_id)).toEqual([a1, b1, a2]);
      // ONE backfill of `ua`, not one per ticket of the project: the exact list holds `ua` once (a separate
      // `toHaveLength(1)` on it could not fail while this line passes, so it is not repeated).
      expect(written.slice(3).map((w) => w.entity_id)).toEqual([ua, a1, a2, ub, b1]);

      expect(await drawn(pa)).toEqual([...beforeA, a1, a2]);
      expect(await drawn(pb)).toEqual([...beforeB, b1]);
    });

    it('a refused set writes no rank and leaves the unranked row unranked; CONTROL: the set minus the refused id then publishes and ranks', async () => {
      const p = await project();
      const [u, live] = [await backlog(p), await backlog(p)];
      const [d2, d1] = [await draft(p), await draft(p)].sort(); // d1 > d2 as strings: the given [d1, d2] is not the ULID order
      const mark = await head();

      const refused = await publishSet('member', [d1, d2, live]);
      expect(refused.statusCode, refused.body).toBe(409);
      expect(refused.json()).toMatchObject({ rule: 'draft.publish-refused', ticketId: live, cause: { rule: 'draft.not-a-draft' } });
      expect(await writtenSince(mark)).toEqual([]);
      expect((await rowsOf(p)).find((row) => row.ticketId === u)?.rank).toBeNull();

      const ok = await publishSet('member', [d1, d2]);
      expect(ok.statusCode, ok.body).toBe(200);
      // CONTROL for the `toEqual([])` above: the same query over the same mark does see a committed set's rows.
      expect((await writtenSince(mark)).map((w) => w.type)).toEqual(['ticket.published', 'ticket.published', 'ticket.ranked', 'ticket.ranked', 'ticket.ranked', 'ticket.ranked']);
      expect((await rowsOf(p)).find((row) => row.ticketId === u)?.rank).not.toBeNull();
      expect((await drawn(p)).slice(-2)).toEqual([d1, d2]);
    });
  });

  describe('28.189 rows the publisher cannot see (R65, Q15)', () => {
    it('leaves a hidden row unranked and the publish succeeds; the owner\'s publish ranks it', async () => {
      const p = await project();
      const [seen, hidden] = [await backlog(p), await backlog(p, 'owner')];
      expect(
        await door(read, 'owner', 'ticket', hidden, 'visibility.set', { ticketId: hidden, mode: 'explicit', userIds: [read.userIds.owner] }),
      ).toMatchObject({ status: 'committed' });
      const d = await draft(p);

      const res = await publishSet('member', [d]);
      expect(res.statusCode, res.body).toBe(200);
      const rows = await rowsOf(p);
      expect(rows.find((row) => row.ticketId === hidden)?.rank).toBeNull();
      expect(rows.find((row) => row.ticketId === seen)?.rank).not.toBeNull();
      expect(await drawn(p)).toEqual([seen, d, hidden]); // the hidden row draws below the new ticket, as a drag leaves it (Q15)

      const od = await draft(p, 'owner');
      expect((await publishSet('owner', [od])).statusCode).toBe(200);
      expect((await rowsOf(p)).find((row) => row.ticketId === hidden)?.rank).not.toBeNull(); // CONTROL: the owner sees it, so it is ranked
      expect((await drawn(p)).slice(-1)).toEqual([od]);
    });
  });

  `packages/domain/test/rank-tail.test.ts` (28.192, domain half):
  ```ts
  import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
  import { compareByRank, isRankKey, planTailRank, type RankAssignment, type RankedRow } from '../src/rank.js';

  const row = (ticketId: string, rank: string | null = null): RankedRow => ({ ticketId, rank });

  /** What the ledger would hold after the assignments, in order, and the order it draws. Ids the rows do not have are new. */
  function drawn(rows: readonly RankedRow[], assignments: readonly RankAssignment[]): string[] {
    const keys = new Map(assignments.map((a) => [a.ticketId, a.rank]));
    const all = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.ticketId, r]));
    for (const a of assignments) if (!all.has(a.ticketId)) all.set(a.ticketId, row(a.ticketId));
    return [...all.values()]
      .map((r) => ({ ticketId: r.ticketId, rank: keys.get(r.ticketId) ?? r.rank }))
      .sort(compareByRank)
      .map((r) => r.ticketId);
  }

  describe('28.192 planTailRank', () => {
    it('backfills the unranked rows in drawn order above the last key, then places the ticket; the ranked rows are not rewritten', () => {
      const rows = [row('B', 'p'), row('A', 'g'), row('D'), row('C')]; // unsorted on purpose
      const plan = planTailRank(rows, ['P']);
      expect(plan.backfill).toEqual([{ ticketId: 'C', rank: 'u' }, { ticketId: 'D', rank: 'x' }]);
      expect(plan.tail).toEqual([{ ticketId: 'P', rank: 'y' }]);
      expect(drawn(rows, [...plan.backfill, ...plan.tail])).toEqual(['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'P']);
      expect([...plan.backfill, ...plan.tail].every((a) => isRankKey(a.rank))).toBe(true);
      // CONTROL: the tail key alone draws ABOVE the unranked rows, the defect the backfill removes
      expect(drawn(rows, plan.tail)).toEqual(['A', 'B', 'P', 'C', 'D']);
    });

    it('does not backfill a placed id that is already among the rows, and places a repeated id once', () => {
      const rows = [row('A', 'g'), row('C'), row('P')];
      const plan = planTailRank(rows, ['P', 'P']);
      expect(plan.backfill).toEqual([{ ticketId: 'C', rank: 'q' }]);
      expect(plan.tail).toEqual([{ ticketId: 'P', rank: 'v' }]);
    });

    it('has no backfill when every row has a key, places several ids in the given order, and re-keys a placed id that held one', () => {
      const ranked = [row('A', 'g'), row('B', 'p')];
      // ['Q', 'P'], not ['P', 'Q']: the given order must differ from the sorted order, or a planner that sorted its
      // tail ids would pass.
      expect(planTailRank(ranked, ['Q', 'P'])).toEqual({
        backfill: [],
        tail: [{ ticketId: 'Q', rank: 'u' }, { ticketId: 'P', rank: 'x' }],
      });
      const again = planTailRank([row('P', 'g'), row('A', 'p')], ['P']);
      expect(again.tail).toEqual([{ ticketId: 'P', rank: 'u' }]);
      expect(drawn([row('P', 'g'), row('A', 'p')], again.tail)).toEqual(['A', 'P']);
    });

    it('places an empty project\'s ids i, r, v, and does not touch its input', () => {
      expect(planTailRank([], ['R', 'P', 'Q'])).toEqual({
        backfill: [],
        tail: [{ ticketId: 'R', rank: 'i' }, { ticketId: 'P', rank: 'r' }, { ticketId: 'Q', rank: 'v' }],
      });
      const rows = Object.freeze([Object.freeze(row('B')), Object.freeze(row('A', 'g'))]);
      const snapshot = JSON.stringify(rows);
      planTailRank(rows, ['P']);
      expect(JSON.stringify(rows)).toBe(snapshot);
    });
  });
  ```
